S1037.reason: An assignee of a real estate purchase contract may enforce specific performance; knowledge of the owner's refusal and the profit motive don't bar equitable relief.

S0107.reason: Personal (ratione personae) immunity attaches to a person in their personal capacity and does not cover State conduct as such.

S0341.reason: Normal adult respiratory rate is about 12-20, so 14-16 breaths per minute is the best fit.
